option_relations.rationale: Chondroma is a type of cartilaginous tumor, and chondrosarcoma is a malignant cartilaginous tumor, so chondroma can be considered a subtype of chondrosarcoma in a broad sense.
Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone is a specific type of chondrosarcoma, which matches the leaf label Chondrosarcoma.
Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement is a specific type of chondrosarcoma, which matches the leaf label Chondrosarcoma.
Benign chondroma is a type of cartilaginous tumor, and chondrosarcoma is a malignant cartilaginous tumor, so benign chondroma can be considered a subtype of chondrosarcoma in a broad sense.
